name: Stop
meaning: Stop before the STOP line, give way to traffic on the major road, and enter only when the way is clear.
meaning_hi: स्टॉप लाइन से पहले रुकें, मुख्य सड़क के यातायात को रास्ता दें और रास्ता साफ होने पर ही आगे बढ़ें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.5.3
auditNote: Audited: name, meaning, category checked. Name, meaning, category, shape and colours consistent with the clause cited
meaning_mr: STOP रेषेच्या आधी थांबा, मुख्य रस्त्यावरील वाहतुकीला मार्ग द्या आणि रस्ता मोकळा असेल तेव्हाच पुढे जा.
meaning_te: STOP గీత ముందు ఆగండి, ప్రధాన రోడ్డులోని ట్రాఫిక్‌కు దారి ఇవ్వండి, దారి ఖాళీగా ఉన్నప్పుడే లోపలికి వెళ్లండి.
meaning_ta: STOP கோட்டுக்கு முன் வாகனத்தை நிறுத்துங்கள்; முக்கியச் சாலையில் வரும் வாகனங்களுக்கு வழிவிடுங்கள்; வழி தெளிவாக இருக்கும்போது மட்டுமே உள்ளே செல்லுங்கள்.

name: Give Way
meaning: Slow down, give way to traffic on the major road, and proceed cautiously.
meaning_hi: धीमे हों, मुख्य सड़क के यातायात को रास्ता दें और सावधानी से आगे बढ़ें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.6.2 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q6 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q6). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: वेग कमी करा, मुख्य रस्त्यावरील वाहतुकीला मार्ग द्या आणि काळजीपूर्वक पुढे जा.
meaning_te: వేగం తగ్గించండి, ప్రధాన రోడ్డులోని ట్రాఫిక్‌కు దారి ఇవ్వండి, జాగ్రత్తగా ముందుకు వెళ్లండి.
meaning_ta: வேகத்தைக் குறையுங்கள்; முக்கியச் சாலையில் வரும் வாகனங்களுக்கு வழிவிட்டு, கவனமாகச் செல்லுங்கள்.

name: No Entry
meaning: Vehicles must not enter from this direction.
meaning_hi: इस दिशा से वाहनों का प्रवेश मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.17
auditNote: Audited: name, meaning, category checked. Name, meaning, category, shape and colours consistent with the clause cited
meaning_mr: वाहनांनी या दिशेने आत येऊ नये.
meaning_te: వాహనాలు ఈ వైపు నుండి లోపలికి ప్రవేశించకూడదు.
meaning_ta: இந்தத் திசையிலிருந்து வாகனங்கள் உள்ளே நுழையக் கூடாது.

name: No Parking
meaning: Parking is prohibited here.
meaning_hi: यहाँ पार्किंग मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.8.5 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q46 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q46). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: येथे पार्किंग करण्यास मनाई आहे.

name: No Overtaking
meaning: Overtaking other vehicles is prohibited.
meaning_hi: दूसरे वाहनों को ओवरटेक करना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.20 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q34 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q34). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: इतर वाहनांना ओव्हरटेक करण्यास मनाई आहे.
meaning_ta: மற்ற வாகனங்களை முந்திச் செல்வது தடை செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது.

name: Speed Limit 40
meaning: Do not exceed 40 km/h.
meaning_hi: 40 किमी/घंटा से अधिक गति न रखें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.9.8
auditNote: Audited: name, meaning, category checked. Name, meaning, category, shape and colours consistent with the clause cited
meaning_mr: 40 किमी/तास पेक्षा जास्त वेग करू नका.

name: No Horn
meaning: Sounding the horn is prohibited.
meaning_hi: हॉर्न बजाना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.16 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q18 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q18). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: हॉर्न वाजवण्यास मनाई आहे.

name: No U-Turn
meaning: U-turns are prohibited.
meaning_hi: यू-टर्न लेना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.21 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q10 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q10). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: यू-टर्न घेण्यास मनाई आहे.

name: No Right Turn
meaning: Right turns are prohibited.
meaning_hi: दाएँ मुड़ना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.19 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q16 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q16). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: उजवीकडे वळण्यास मनाई आहे.

name: No Left Turn
meaning: Left turns are prohibited.
meaning_hi: बाएँ मुड़ना मना है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.7.19 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q58 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q58). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: डावीकडे वळण्यास मनाई आहे.

name: Ahead Only
meaning: Vehicles must go straight ahead only.
meaning_hi: वाहन केवल सीधे जाएँ।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.11.2 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q68 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q68). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: वाहनांनी फक्त सरळ पुढे जावे.

name: Compulsory Turn Left
meaning: Vehicles must turn left.
meaning_hi: वाहन को बाएँ मुड़ना अनिवार्य है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 14.11.3 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q4 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q4). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: वाहनांनी डावीकडे वळावे.

name: Left Hairpin Bend
meaning: Sharp bend to the left ahead; slow down.
meaning_hi: आगे बाएँ तीखा मोड़ है; गति धीमी करें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.5 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q80 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q80). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: पुढे डावीकडे तीव्र वळण आहे; वेग कमी करा.
meaning_te: ముందు ఎడమవైపు తీవ్రమైన మలుపు ఉంది; వేగం తగ్గించండి.
meaning_ta: முன்னால் இடதுபுறம் கூர்மையான வளைவு; வேகத்தைக் குறையுங்கள்.

name: Narrow Bridge
meaning: The bridge ahead is narrow; slow down and take care.
meaning_hi: आगे पुल संकरा है; धीमे चलें और सावधानी रखें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.20 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q20 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q20). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: पुढील पूल अरुंद आहे; वेग कमी करा आणि काळजी घ्या.
meaning_te: ముందున్న వంతెన ఇరుకుగా ఉంది; వేగం తగ్గించి జాగ్రత్తగా వెళ్లండి.
meaning_ta: முன்னால் உள்ள பாலம் குறுகியது; வேகத்தைக் குறைத்துக் கவனமாகச் செல்லுங்கள்.

name: School Ahead
meaning: School nearby; expect children, slow down.
meaning_hi: पास में स्कूल है; बच्चों की आशंका, धीमे चलें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.28 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q114 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q114). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: जवळ शाळा आहे; मुले असू शकतात, वेग कमी करा.
meaning_te: దగ్గరలో పాఠశాల ఉంది; పిల్లలు ఉండవచ్చు, వేగం తగ్గించండి.
meaning_ta: அருகில் பள்ளி உள்ளது; குழந்தைகள் வரக்கூடும், வேகத்தைக் குறையுங்கள்.

name: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: Pedestrian crossing ahead; be ready to stop.
meaning_hi: आगे पैदल पारपथ है; रुकने के लिए तैयार रहें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.27 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q12 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q12). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: पुढे पादचारी क्रॉसिंग आहे; थांबण्यास तयार राहा.
meaning_te: ముందు పాదచారుల క్రాసింగ్ ఉంది; ఆగడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉండండి.
meaning_ta: முன்னால் பாதசாரிகள் கடக்கும் இடம்; நிறுத்தத் தயாராக இருங்கள்.

name: Men at Work
meaning: Road works ahead; slow down and be careful.
meaning_hi: आगे सड़क का काम चल रहा है; सावधानी से धीमे चलें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.34 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q116 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q116). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: पुढे रस्त्याचे काम सुरू आहे; वेग कमी करा आणि काळजी घ्या.
meaning_te: ముందు రోడ్డు పనులు జరుగుతున్నాయి; వేగం తగ్గించి జాగ్రత్తగా ఉండండి.
meaning_ta: முன்னால் சாலைப் பணி நடக்கிறது; வேகத்தைக் குறைத்துக் கவனமாக இருங்கள்.

name: Cattle
meaning: Animals may be on the road; slow down.
meaning_hi: सड़क पर पशु हो सकते हैं; धीमे चलें।
sourceDoc: Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q112 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q112). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: रस्त्यावर जनावरे असू शकतात; वेग कमी करा.

name: Slippery Road
meaning: Road may be slippery; reduce speed, avoid sudden braking.
meaning_hi: सड़क फिसलन भरी हो सकती है; गति कम करें, अचानक ब्रेक न लगाएँ।
sourceDoc: Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q106 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q106). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: रस्ता निसरडा असू शकतो; वेग कमी करा, अचानक ब्रेक लावू नका.
meaning_te: రోడ్డు జారేలా ఉండవచ్చు; వేగం తగ్గించండి, ఒక్కసారిగా బ్రేక్ వేయకండి.
meaning_ta: சாலை வழுக்கலாம்; வேகத்தைக் குறையுங்கள், திடீரென பிரேக் போடாதீர்கள்.

name: Roundabout
meaning: Roundabout ahead; slow down and give way to traffic already on it.
meaning_hi: आगे गोलचक्कर है; धीमे हों और उस पर पहले से चल रहे यातायात को रास्ता दें।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.12 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q92 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q92). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: पुढे वर्तुळाकार चौक आहे; वेग कमी करा आणि आधीपासून चौकात असलेल्या वाहनांना मार्ग द्या.
meaning_te: ముందు రౌండ్‌అబౌట్ ఉంది; వేగం తగ్గించి, అందులో ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న వాహనాలకు దారి ఇవ్వండి.
meaning_ta: முன்னால் ரவுண்டானா; வேகத்தைக் குறைத்து, ஏற்கெனவே அதில் செல்லும் வாகனங்களுக்கு வழிவிடுங்கள்.

name: T-Junction
meaning: Road ends at a T-junction ahead.
meaning_hi: आगे सड़क टी-चौराहे पर समाप्त होती है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 15.14 ; Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q90 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q90). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: पुढे टी-जंक्शनवर रस्ता संपतो.

name: Parking
meaning: A designated parking place.
meaning_hi: यह निर्धारित पार्किंग स्थान है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 3.3 (facility signs)
auditNote: Audited: name, meaning, category checked. Name, meaning, category, shape and colours consistent with the clause cited
meaning_mr: ठरवून दिलेली पार्किंगची जागा.

name: Hospital
meaning: A hospital is nearby; drive quietly, avoid horn.
meaning_hi: पास में अस्पताल है; शांति से चलाएँ, हॉर्न न बजाएँ।
sourceDoc: Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q22 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q22). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: जवळ रुग्णालय आहे; शांतपणे चालवा, हॉर्न वाजवू नका.
meaning_te: దగ్గరలో ఆసుపత్రి ఉంది; నెమ్మదిగా నడపండి, హారన్ వాడకండి.
meaning_ta: அருகில் மருத்துவமனை உள்ளது; அமைதியாக ஓட்டுங்கள், ஹாரன் ஒலிக்காதீர்கள்.

name: Petrol Pump
meaning: Fuel station ahead.
meaning_hi: आगे ईंधन स्टेशन है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 3.3 (facility signs)
auditNote: Audited: name, meaning, category checked. Emoji pictogram is recognisable but not the official artwork
meaning_mr: पुढे इंधन केंद्र आहे.

name: First Aid Post
meaning: First aid is available here.
meaning_hi: यहाँ प्राथमिक उपचार उपलब्ध है।
sourceDoc: Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q24 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q24). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: येथे प्रथमोपचार उपलब्ध आहे.

name: Telephone
meaning: A public telephone is available.
meaning_hi: यहाँ सार्वजनिक टेलीफोन उपलब्ध है।
sourceDoc: Not yet confirmed against an official source
auditNote: Not found in IRC:67 facility-sign list checked; confirm the sign exists
meaning_mr: सार्वजनिक टेलिफोन उपलब्ध आहे.

name: Eating Place
meaning: Food is available nearby.
meaning_hi: पास में भोजन उपलब्ध है।
sourceDoc: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs - cl. 3.3 (facility signs)
auditNote: Audited: name, meaning, category checked. Emoji pictogram is recognisable but not the official artwork
meaning_mr: जवळ खाण्याची सोय आहे.

name: Resting Place
meaning: A place to rest is nearby.
meaning_hi: पास में विश्राम स्थल है।
sourceDoc: Parivahan learner-licence question bank, STALL_QB_ENGLISH_NEW.pdf (2015 edition), Q26 (picture and name)
auditNote: Picture replaced with the official sign picture from the Parivahan question bank (Q26). Name and meaning match the bank.
meaning_mr: जवळ विश्रांतीची जागा आहे.
